demo.title: harness-capu.sh
demo.code:
# Set up wallet-owned OpenCAP inference with a chosen purchase budget
bankr prompt "Buy $50 of CAPU on Base, stake it, and create my OpenCAP API key"

# Use CAPU already in the wallet
bankr prompt "Stake my 1 CAPU and set up OpenCAP with a $1 daily key budget"

# Check today's allocation and remaining credit
bankr prompt "Check my CAPU stake and OpenCAP quota"

# Recover a safely stored key through a private handoff
bankr prompt "I lost my OpenCAP API key; recover it from the secret store"

# Revoke an exposed key and create a replacement
bankr prompt "My OpenCAP API key was exposed. Rotate it"

setup: Use the Base wallet that should own the OpenCAP account; its signer must support Ethereum personal-message signing, or use the browser handoff
Buy CAPU within the user's budget or use existing CAPU; staking is on the CAPU token itself at 0x67558d3D990EA40b64fD37FBd5c4860d1f9B3a9F, with no CAPU approval
Each staked CAPU funds $1/day of inference credit, renewed at 00:00 UTC without rollover; buying CAP or staking sCAP is optional

Sign in through the gateway's SIWE nonce/verify flow, then create an inference key with the account token; authenticated flow documented from the deployed dashboard and requires wallet validation during setup
Save the inference key as OPENCAP_API_KEY and hand it off privately once; keep the account token private. CAP_API_KEY is a separate trading-wallet credential
Client base URL: https://gw.capminal.ai/api/inference/v1. Browser setup and key management: https://www.capminal.ai/gateway
